series.name: HDU-42CA03 ducted (model-scoped)
series.notes: Model-scoped ducted meanings (Arlington technician table). E0/E1/E3/E7 conflict with split meanings — never merge.

meaning.en: Condensate drain line clogged or drain system fault on HDU-42CA03.
meaning.ur: HDU-42CA03 par condensate drain line band hai ya drain system kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean the condensate drain line and clear any blockage
solutions.ur: Condensate drain line saaf karke blockage hatayein

solutions.en: Call a technician if the drain fault remains
solutions.ur: kharabi baqi rahe to technician blaiyn

notes.en: Model-scoped meaning differs from split E0 (appliancecodehub indoor-sensor framing). Single technician source → medium.
notes.ur: Is model ka matlab split E0 (appliancecodehub indoor-sensor wale framing) se alag hai. Sirf ek technician source → medium.

meaning.en: On this ducted model E1 indicates high compressor pressure / piping or installation issue — NOT the split-code room sensor meaning.
meaning.ur: is ducted model par E1 compressor ka zyada pressure / piping ya installation ka masla hai — split ke kamre ke sensor wale matlab se alag

causes.ur: compressor zyada pressure par chal raha hai
piping ka masla ya ghalat installation

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and remove restrictions

solutions.ur: technician compressor aur installation check kare

notes.en: Meaning conflict with split E1 is model-scoped, not an error — keep series separate.
notes.ur: Split E1 ke sath matlab ka conflict model-scoped hai, ghalati nahi — series ko alag alag rakhein.

title.ur: Heat exchanger jam jana ya barf jama hona

meaning.en: Display shows "E" when the internal heat exchanger is iced over from low airflow.
meaning.ur: andaar ka heat exchanger hawa kam hone se barf se jam jaye to display par "E" aata hai

causes.en: Heat exchanger frozen or fully covered with ice
causes.ur: heat exchanger jam gaya ya poori tarah barf se cover ho gaya hai

solutions.ur: 10–15 minute band rakh kar defrost karein

solutions.en: Clean/replace filters and clear return grilles; call technician if ice returns
solutions.ur: Filters saaf karein ya badlein aur return grilles saaf karein; ice wapas aaye to technician bulayein

notes.en: Bare "E" display is distinct from E-series numeric codes.
notes.ur: Khali "E" display E-series ke numeric codes se alag hai.

meaning.en: Compressor low-pressure protection from leak or undercharge on this ducted model.
meaning.ur: is dacutd model par lyk ya kam gas se kam dba ki hifazat

solutions.en: Leak-check cooling coils, compressor, condenser, evaporator and repair
solutions.ur: Coil, compressor, condenser aur evaporator ki leak check karke marammat karein

solutions.en: Recharge with correct gas quantity under service
solutions.ur: service ke under durust miqdar mein gas bharwayein

notes.en: E3 not on official split table; meaning here is ducted-specific.
notes.ur: E3 official split table par nahi; yahan ka matlab ducted-specific hai.

meaning.en: On this ducted model E7 is remote-control reception failure — NOT indoor/outdoor communication (split meaning).
meaning.ur: Is ducted model par E7 remote control reception ki naqami hai — indoor/outdoor communication wala split matlab nahin.

causes.en: Indoor module not receiving remote commands
causes.ur: Indoor module remote ke commands receive nahi kar raha

causes.en: Remote out of range, blocked path, or dead batteries
causes.ur: remote had se bahar, rasta band ya battery khatam

solutions.en: Move remote in range, clear obstructions, replace batteries
solutions.ur: Remote ko range mein le aayein, rukawat hata dein, battery badlein

solutions.en: Technician inspects the receiver module if error persists
solutions.ur: kharabi baqi rahe to technician receiver module check kare

notes.en: Major model-scoped conflict with split E7 (communication). Keep series separate.
notes.ur: Split E7 (communication) ke sath bara model-scoped conflict hai. Series ko alag alag rakhein.

meaning.en: Unit not receiving valid power — wiring, plug, or supply board fault.
meaning.ur: unit ko durust bijli nahin mil rahi — wiring, plug ya supply board kharab

causes.ur: markazi zariye se bijli nahin aa rahi

causes.en: Loose/damaged power wiring or faulty supply
causes.ur: dheeli (loose)/kharab power wiring ya kharab supply

solutions.en: Verify plug is seated and main is on
solutions.ur: plug lage hua hai aur main on hai, tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Repair wiring; electrician/technician replaces faulty supply
solutions.ur: wiring ki marammat karein; electrician/technician kharab supply badlein

notes.en: FF not seen on official split table.
notes.ur: FF official split table par nahi milta.
